notes:
Discovery notes: customer builds an in-IDE copilot aimed at enterprise dev teams. Wants function/tool calling for: running unit tests (pytest/jest), lint passes (eslint/golangci-lint), and streaming build logs into the editor. Key ask: sandboxed, ephemeral execution with strict time & disk quotas; non-privileged containers; stdout/stderr capture and structured results back to agent.

Quote from CTO: "We need to let the assistant run tests and report structured failures without opening a remote shell to our infra. Security must be airtight."

Model requirements: low-latency streaming (sub-150ms token arrival in IDE), model/version pinning per workspace, routing fallback to smaller quantized models for quick completions. Careful about KV cache and prompt leakage between tenants — wants per-workspace isolation.

Cost sensitivity: medium-high — willing to pay for Dedicated if unit economics for CI tasks are clear. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching test-run requests and cache reuse.

Stubs: Fireflies ff_2026-02-04 (demo + infra Qs). Pricing deck link in Drive. Jira RED-9342 created for sandbox runner spec.

use_case_brief: Build an IDE copilot that can safely execute project-local test suites, run linters, and stream CI/build logs back to the developer. Function-calling hooks should accept a sandbox spec (time limit, mounts, env), return structured test results and artifacts, and support deterministic replay for debugging.
technical_requirements: time limits and filesystem quotas on runners
streaming websocket for build log tailing
model pinning per workspace and package-version routing
poc_scope: 30-day sandbox: integrate Redwood SDK into internal VS Code extension -> expose 3 function calls: run_tests, run_lint, stream_build_logs. Limit to Node/Python repos. Run tests in ephemeral containers with 5m timeout. Deliver example logs + structured JSON result for each run.
decision_criteria: POC demonstrates reproducible test results and streaming latency <200ms for completions
acceptable unit cost for routine lint/test runs
ability to pin models and rollback quickly
